While rare, some ki warriors branch out into other magics. You, like such individuals, have learned how to convert one type of internal energy to another. You could turn ki into mana, mana into spiritual energy, spiritual energy into bioenergy, or any number of other conversions. Some energies may be more efficiently converted than others.

While most would think of ki warriors as eschewing armor in favor of added mobility, this isn’t always the case, as even some knight orders are ki warriors. Like them, you can ignore the weight and restrictiveness of anything you wear that is designed to protect, including most clothing and armor, it simply doesn’t weigh you down, impede your movement, or cause you harm, such as metal armor growing too hot in the sun.

Ki techniques are not just for combat, in fact, the first techniques were more about learning control and were adopted by craftsmen and religious orders. Ki is able to be used to augment nearly any skill as a result. You find that you can combine your ki use with nearly any other skill, be it the breathing techniques to blow glass of exquisite quality to gaining a higher connection with a higher power, and everything in between and beyond. 

This can even be inverted, allowing your use of various skills to be integrated into your ki use, opening up new pathways and techniques based on your understanding of their interactions. Effectively, this allows you to create ki techniques based on your non-combat skills and use them both in and out of combat.

You have an uncanny ability to use just about anything as an effective weapon, no matter how ridiculous such a notion seems. From tavern brawls using mugs and chairs to improvising a weapon out of simple scrap found in an alley while on the run to using a person as a potential weapon in a pinch. This has the added benefit of allowing you to effectively use weaponry that is oddly balanced or unwieldy where their oddity becomes a boon rather than a hindrance.

Often, a ki warrior will name their techniques for the ease of explaining them, however, some ki warriors have found that, by invoking the name of their technique as they are using it, they subconsciously put more into the technique, giving it more power. They can still use the technique even if they don’t invoke the name with no downside. This increase in power does not sacrifice control or precision.

While not always the case, many ki warriors possess some form of natural affinity within their ki, for an element, for an animal, for a particular tool, for a concept, or even for a specific philosophy of thought. This affinity shapes the ki, makes certain abilities stronger or easier to use, and can unlock unique skills or techniques only those with an affinity can utilize. You naturally possess a single, strong affinity. This option may be taken multiple times.

For 300 CP: You can cultivate an affinity, building up your natural resonance with something until it becomes a full fledged affinity. This does not grant you any affinities by default.

For ki warriors, the ability to sense their own ki is only the first step, the next is to be able to sense the ki of others, regardless of how small it may be. You have an additional sense that allows you to both perceive the world around you and sense people at a distance based entirely on your own ki. You can even identify specific people based on the feeling of their own ki, or other energies. The range of this sensing will grow with use and practice, but it starts out reaching across the size of a football field.

As mentioned prior, many ki warriors prioritize flexibility and mobility over the protection of armor, but some still use it regardless. These individuals learn to make the most of the protection offered by their armor. Any armor you wear is both reinforced by its own components and resonates with your ki, providing your physical body with some of the armor's durability and resistances. 

Armor made with pieces resistant to acid, for example, would have all of it be resistant to acid, not just those pieces, and you, as the wearer, would gain some of that acid resistance on top of the normal protection the armor provides. Any defensive properties are carried across through this method. Additionally, your own durability reinforces the armor you wear, ensuring the armor will always provide some level of additional protection beyond your own physique.

Your abilities are shockingly easy to mix and combine, even those that should have conflicting natures, allowing you to utilize these abilities or powers in tandem even when they should be mutually exclusive or cause injury when both are used together. You also find that your abilities cannot harm you from their use. This even extends to external sources of power, though to a slightly lesser extent.

Medicine is always of use to a ki warrior, but some take this a fair bit farther than simple medicine, creating potent medicinal drugs that can augment their abilities, often with terrible side effects. You know a mix of traditional medicine, alchemy, and ki use that allows you to create various medicines, often taking the form of pills. These offer much the same benefits as potions do in traditional fantasy, but can have negative side effects added to improve their power. The more severe the side effects, the more potent the medicine becomes.

You have the ability to imbue your ki into an object or tool to temporarily enhance its properties, making a sword sharper, enhancing the durability of a shield, or similar such qualities. Long term exposure to ki or working the ki into the object as it is being created can render some or all of these traits permanent, needing no further infusions to maintain, but still being able to be infused for additional strength. Depending on your skill with ki, you may be able to manifest more mystical traits rather than merely enhancing what is already present.

A potentially lesser known art of the ki warriors, they are able to shape the flows of natural energies within an area based on the placement of certain objects, the presence of certain colors, the textures of specific materials, and similar such things, creating an area where the energy naturally works towards a specific end. Work towards that end within the bounds of this area are enhanced as a result, such as a workshop designed to optimize workflow would allow for faster crafting speeds while a sparring arena would enhance learning and reduce injury chances for those actually sparring, but have no effect on an actual battle.

Ki is the essence of life, and in that vein, it is incredibly good at dealing with the dead in one way or another. You can interact with spiritual entities that lack a physical form as if they did possess a physical form, can expel them from a person's body, channel a willing spirit yourself, or otherwise interact with spiritual beings of all sorts. You also find that you do far more damage to creatures antithetical to life, such as most forms of undead.

Not all ki users are warriors, some, in fact, are healers, as is shown by the discipline of reiki, or spirit healing. You know a number of mundane techniques, such as massage, acupuncture, aromatherapy, and similar such methods, that help to calm and relax the body as well as being receptive to the use of ki, which can amplify their effectiveness and offer greater benefits as a result. You can also simply use your ki to heal, whether yourself or someone you touch (though this is less efficient), or transfer energy from yourself to another.

Ki warriors are primarily known for the physical prowess that their ki provides them, however, some have turned their use of ki towards something more akin to magic. You have the ability to create constructs out of your ki and project your ki techniques across a greater distance, allowing them to affect others rather than being self targeted or needing to be able to touch someone to use such techniques. Moreover, you can replicate certain spells with your ki as a medium for it and, with training, may be able to do the same for other energies.

Additionally, you maintain control over your ki techniques even once they are complete or separated from you, such as being able to redirect a common ki blast or construct to perform actions at a range at your will, even though they are no longer directly connected to you.

Your ki is exceptionally pure, free of impurity or corruption of any kind, rendering it more effective than it otherwise would be. Your ki is twice as potent and you have twice as much of it as another ki warrior without this advantage. Additionally, nothing will ever be able to seal away, steal, corrupt, or otherwise affect your ki unless you allow it to happen in the first place.

Ki is a mystery to even some of its own users, with a number of ki warriors working off of instinct alone or simply learning established methods with little variation beyond minor deviations. You, however, know how ki works, you know its mechanisms, and you know how each of them can be combined to create new techniques. With this perk, you have a grounded foundation in the principles of ki and know enough to develop, invent, and refine your own ki techniques.

With the presence of ki sensors, it only makes sense that some ki warriors would learn to avoid detection from those that could otherwise sense them. You have learned how to suppress your ki signature, making it incredibly hard to perceive or detect, even when you are actively using them. This has the added benefit of making your techniques incredibly difficult to counter or detect the build up of them.

While ki warriors are known for their control and discipline, there are times when they need to let loose with their displeasure. Like these individuals, you can project your intent and emotions out to impact those around you. Comfort them with your feeling of joy or your intent to help or intimidate them with your intent to kill them, possibly causing them to freeze up entirely. Additionally, your emotions can have an effect on your ki when they are controlled and channeled properly.

A breakthrough is a moment where a ki warrior’s understanding of ki suddenly leaps forward, inspired by something and able to push them farther along their path than they otherwise would have been able to. You can now experience these breakthroughs yourself, having sudden leaps in understanding when certain conditions are met or inspiration hits you in a moment of clarity. Moreover, when you hit these breakthroughs, you enter a sort of enhanced flow state as your understanding develops rapidly in the moment.

You are one of the few that can call themselves a master of ki, with a nearly perfect level of control and efficiency over it, able to shift from calm and gentle streams to sudden explosive bursts of power, and anything in between. This level of control grants you a great deal of efficiency in your techniques, cutting the ki necessary to perform a technique to a third of what it should be, and can be trained to be even more efficient with specific techniques.

Besides the control, this also grants you a high resistance to any technique that might harm you, such as a ki technique that overclocks your body that would normally cause muscle tearing and bone fractures, you’d simply feel a little soreness unless you really pushed the technique.

While technically a variant of ki techniques, seals are a far more nuanced and precise art with a need for careful preparation and various materials to accomplish, being something few ki warriors actually learn as a result. You, however, have learned the principles of these techniques and can apply them quite well.

You know how to effectively use and create seals, ki rituals, and similar such techniques, and even possess a great deal of actual knowledge about existing ones already. You can create wards, storage devices, and explosive ordinances, seal away beasts, powers, or corruption, conjure barriers, summonable creatures, and similar such things, all using these principles.

Not a literal dragon’s heart, but a symbolic one that takes the form of a jade statue. A person placing their hand on this statue gets a feel for ki, gaining the Ki Presence perk and developing abilities similar to those described in this document. If, instead, you let a drop of blood infused with ki drop onto the statue, with the intent to do so, you can spread this effect across the world, imbuing people from all corners to develop abilities as if you had used this item directly, as if they had used the statue normally. However, if you do so, the statue loses its power until the start of the next jump.

Ki is a nebulous power, but one you possess the ability to develop. You have a sense for your own ki, how to move it, the very basics of ki as a whole, even if you do or don’t actually know what it is, the end result is the same.

You have the minimum knowledge to be considered an alchemist. You know how to perform the seven alchemical processes (Calcination, Dissolution, Separation, Conjunction, Fermentation, Distillation, and Coagulation), what the five elements are (Air, Earth, Fire, Water, and Aether), and you know the three reagents (Mercury, Sulfur, and Salt). You also know the interplay of Mind, Spirit, and Body.

Also known as practical alchemy or alchemistry, you know how to make potions using natural materials that have been put through the alchemical processes. The strength of these potions is based on how well you perform the processes, the quality of the ingredients, and the amount of aetheric power (represented by mental stamina) you invest into the potion during its creation. It is also possible to create variations on potions such as oils, soaps, candles, incense, inks, or candies. You are also not beholden to making the effects entirely beneficial and can, for example, make a poison with this knowledge.

An alchemist is, usually, nothing without materials to work with, so you’ve learned how to get those materials. You know what materials to look for and how to harvest them effectively without harming their quality, as well as where they can most likely be found in any given environment.

You gain the knowledge of how to cultivate the various materials you need, at least for those that can be cultivated, including growing various plants and fungi, as well as how to raise a wide variety of animals that have useful parts.

You have a considerable amount of skill with explosives, how to make them, implement them, shape their charges, everything you could need to know about the production and use of explosives. This does not, however, cover nuclear bombs or anything in a similar vein. Additionally, you have an exceptionally good throwing arm, able to throw farther and faster than one would expect and with pinpoint accuracy, and for more than just grenades; you’re practiced in throwing nearly anything effectively.

You have the ability to make your potions toxic, pairing a benefit with a detriment of some variety in order to strengthen the benefits of the potion. You also find that your resistance to poison, diseases, and potion toxicity increases with exposure, allowing you to ignore some of the detriments of such potions. This also makes it so that any poison you make or use are faster acting and more intense, if you want them to be.

Sometimes, you just can’t find a hundred year old mountain ginseng or the blood of a two hundred year old dragon, so, you improvise. You can find a viable substitute for even the most rare, obscure, and seemingly critical materials for just about anything that would require such materials. While these materials may be rare themselves, having more options makes it more likely you will find something regardless. The potency of your creation may suffer a bit from these substitutions or may express unusual quirks, with more substitutions resulting in more divergence, but they will remain serviceable to their purpose.

Most potions are stored in glassware of some kind, which can be quite fragile at the best and worst of times, making carrying them with you a risk. Not anymore. Anything you have stored on your person will be much harder to break or degrade in any fashion unless you actively want it to break in some fashion. You also know several methods to store fragile objects in such a way that they are much harder to break in general, as well as how to keep them from direct strikes that would break them deliberately.

You know how to accelerate or slow various reactions both inside and outside the realm of alchemy, allowing you to more easily control the processes of alchemy. Heating something in flame will happen faster, unfavorable reactions in a solution will complete more slowly or be stopped entirely, fermenting alcohol can occur practically overnight. 

The exact rate at which a process can be accelerated or slowed, as well as how precisely they can be applied, is determined by how well practiced you are at doing so. This can be made to persist for a time without you being present, but this, likewise, takes practice.

You are a skilled writer, both in terms of creating manuscripts detailing your alchemical findings and pursuits, but also in the writing of fictional stories. You never suffer from writer’s block and can ensure that what you write is evocative and easily understood, relatively speaking, by the targeted demographic. Finally, your books can teach in your stead, adding about a third of your skills as a teacher (and any boosts to teaching speed) to the rate at which one can learn something from your books.

You have in depth knowledge of the symbols, pictographs, shapes, and patterns that carry some measure of meaning and power as well as how they can be used in the process of alchemy or magic. While it is possible to learn them and figure out how to put them together as you go, it is a time consuming process that requires a lot of trial and error, where an error can have severe side effects. 

You gain an increased skill in drawing and have an eye for measurements in terms of length and angles that would allow you to draw a complex alchemical circle without any tools other than your own hands, eyes, and a drawing implement.

You have in depth knowledge of several methods to effectively preserve nearly any perishable materials long term without reducing their potency or effectiveness when used in alchemy, as well as how to preserve specific qualities or characteristics while allowing others to decay, if such a thing would be beneficial. This can be easily translated to preserving other supernatural qualities.

It is a common thing for alchemists to hide their notes and insights behind various forms of code and cryptograph to keep rivals from learning what they are capable of. You have a natural talent for cryptography, both in using and solving them, as well as being able to develop simple codes that are surprisingly difficult for other people to solve but is utterly intuitive for you.

Alchemists, for all of their associations, are scientists, and any good scientist will know quite a bit about basic mechanics. You have taken that to another level entirely. You have a talent for the construction and utilization of mechanical devices of all sorts, as well as how to create devices that can aid you in a variety of tasks, such as clockwork contraptions that can add specific measures of materials to a reaction regularly.

One aspect of alchemy that is almost ubiquitous is how easily it can be used to heal, with a great many alchemists being known as famous doctors as well. You have an extensive knowledge of anatomy in regards to the human body, mundane medicine, and an understanding of surgical techniques, allowing you to act as a quite skilled doctor or medic. Moreover, you can easily expand this knowledge to other life forms besides just humans, such as animals, fantasy races, or even artificial creatures like homunculi.

The theory behind a skill is often ignored in favor of the practical, slowing the progress of such skills as they lose sight of what is possible for the easier path of what they already possess. You don’t have this problem as you come to understand the theory of the things you practice at a slow, but steady, rate as you practice those skills, ensuring you never lose out on the theory behind the skills you practice. Additionally, this passively reinforces your skills so they will never grow dull or rusty.

When you make something and actually put a significant effort into it, it just comes out better, as if you had used better quality materials and had better equipment to work with. This improves nearly all aspects of the crafted object, including any supernatural qualities it may possess, as it has the quality of its craftsmanship and materials overcome through skill. If done with superior materials and tools, this can compound significantly to create something truly spectacular.

You possess a wellspring of additional intelligence and creativity within your mind, either from direct cultivation or as a byproduct of the alchemical materials you have worked with over the years. You can tap into this heightened intelligence and creativity, however, doing so suppresses your morals, inhibitions, and empathy, and the deeper you drink from this poisoned wellspring, the more this suppression affects you. 

You can bring yourself out of it, given enough willpower, but drink deep enough and you could become stuck in this state until something knocks you out of it or you chip away at it for an extended period of time.

There is actually a limit to how deep this wellspring goes, acting to, at most, double your intelligence and triple your creativity baseline, however, given time and, maybe, some alchemical adjustments, this could be improved upon, in a number of different ways.

You have the ability to empower the effects of any empowerment placed on you by a factor of five (x5) without reducing its duration. This also allows you to maintain the effects of any empowerment placed on you with your own energy and/or stamina.

You have the ability to lengthen the effects of any empowerment placed on you with a duration by a factor of five (x5) without diluting its potency. This also reduces the costs to maintain an effect by an equal amount, making it take a tenth of the cost to keep an effect going.

You have learned a number of unusual alchemical processes that can be used to allow for normally non-renewable resources, such as metals, to be renewed in some fashion, effectively allowing you to treat such materials as a plant that can be cultivated. You also know how to recreate certain magical properties in baser materials to turn them into alchemically active variations.

You are able to draw out some of the innate properties of a material or substance and allow it to project that property in some small fashion, creating a Pure form of that material. This works best with metals, but can be quite effective with non-metallic materials. While a pure material is in contact with an individual, even through clothing, it grants a few minor abilities, such as Pure Silver having a disease warding effect as well as a bastion against supernatural influences.

You know a process by which you can create what is known as a neutral catalyst; a potion or other object that carries no effect of its own but is receptive to supernatural powers. By channeling a supernatural ability into the catalyst, it takes on the effects of that supernatural ability. It can also be mixed with a few drops of a potion or a supernatural phenomena to take on that potion’s original effects at the same level of strength. You can direct how a spell or supernatural power manifests in this catalyst.

You have a truly prodigal mind, one that is able to process and absorb information exceptionally quickly, increasing your learning speed by ten times what it once was, but only for new alchemical pursuits. Additionally, you have a sort of intuition that guides your alchemical pursuits, giving you brief flashes of inspiration and insight that can help you to progress your alchemical knowledge even without a teacher or source of information to draw on.

Alchemy isn’t all about potions and transmutation, it is also about the creation of devices that carry the mystical and supernatural qualities put into them. You have learned how to use alchemy to create various artifacts with supernatural effects in a form of enchanting, using what properties you can pull out from the materials and combining them to create something new.

You have the ability to use what you have ingested in order to perform alchemical processes within your own body, allowing you to create alchemical products using only your body as a medium. The resulting product can either be expelled from your body or used to affect yourself immediately on creation. Only materials ingested within the last 24 hours are viable for this. Additionally, your jaws, teeth, and digestive tract are more resilient, allowing you to safely consume and draw sustenance from a much wider variety of materials.

You have the ability to create alchemical compounds, a proper fusion of similar materials that combine and bring out new qualities in a way normal reactions cannot. This takes the metaphysical properties of the materials used in the compound and brings them to the surface, combining the results into an altogether new set of properties, often with supernatural results. While this is easiest with minerals such as copper, carbon, and iron, it can also be used on non-mineral substances such as herbs and solvents, however, this requires considerable practice and a lot of experimentation to even begin to achieve.

Many of the materials and creations of alchemy have a tendency to be a bit unstable, leading to explosive results when not handled with care. At least by most. When you work with something that is unstable, it acts as if it were stable so long as it remains in your care and possession, to the point even a chemical that can, and will, spontaneously combust for no apparent reason will remain entirely shelf stable so long as it is in your possession, even if you have it jostling around in your backpack. This will last until you choose to let the effect drop or the substance is no longer in your possession.

You are practiced in the destructive Black Art of Negredo. Negredo, as a form of magic, associates with the concept of entropy and works to degrade anything it comes into contact with, breaking down the bonds that hold something together. Using Negredo, it is possible to unravel supernatural effects, tear down barriers, and reduce physical matter to ashes. Life and metabolic processes tend to hinder the effects of Negredo, but it can still be used to harm with relative ease, both directly and indirectly. Negredo requires physical contact to function, at least at first, and is physically draining to the user.

You are practiced in the analytical White Art of Albedo. Albedo, as a form of magic, associates with the concepts of divination and observation, granting the ability to see that which cannot be seen, hear what cannot be heard, and similar such abilities, as well as a method through which the information gained from such observations can be sorted and archived to be easily accessed later, forming a sort of magical repository of information that you can grant others access to or access yourself. It can also be used to manipulate your senses or those of others given enough time and training.

You are practiced in the refining Yellow Art of Citrinitas. Citinitas, as a form of magic, associates with transformation, able to reshape and alter the material of a physical object or being in some manner, from keeping a blade sharp through its use to changing one’s own face to healing wounds. You can also use it to augment or enhance qualities within an object or individual (yourself included) temporarily, bringing out or hiding features, removing or adding impurities into something or someone, or speeding or slowing certain effects or conditions, proportionally increasing or decreasing the effects, respectively.

You are practiced in the unifying Red Art of Rubedo. Rubedo, as a form of magic, associates with the concepts of unity and harmony, granting the ability to attune and harmonize various concepts and traits together in order to form magical effects, keep balance between opposing forces, and interact with the spiritual in a variety of unique ways. This also allows for the linking of various concepts, and can be used to combine objects, spells, effects, forces, the like to create new effects. This is often mistaken for being part of citrinitas but is more conceptual in nature.

While alchemy is often related to the refinement of the physical world to be closer to the spiritual, or a way to refine living beings, it is also capable of creating new life or semblances of life. You know how to create golems, homunculi, and chimera using alchemy.

Other forms of living alchemy may exist, however, those are for you to discover and are not granted immediately by this perk, though should you develop those abilities, they will become a part of this perk and backed like the above abilities are.

If you possess the Potioncraft perk, you can also create elixirs, a type of potion that can cause the creation of a golem, homunculus, or chimera, with specific parameters determined during the creation of the elixir.

You have learned how to use a nearly meditative state to apply alchemical properties to your own body, allowing you to refine and empower your body, mind, and soul in some form or another. Using this process, you are able to use this meditation to improve on any facet of your physical, mental, or spiritual nature in some way, up to the limits of your physique, both physical and metaphysical. You can also use this as a method to remove impurities in your body, mind, or soul, removing corrupting influences, diseases, poisons, or imperfections that limit your growth and progress to a degree.

Moreover, this can be used to unlock latent traits, powers, potential, or genetic abilities that would otherwise remain dormant, even allowing you to achieve greater limits than you could otherwise achieve. This can even allow the growth of traits that are normally incapable of growth. For example, in a world where your magical strength is determined at birth, you could use this method to grow your magical strength beyond what you were born with.

A wide array of flasks, beakers, alembics, and other forms of glassware useful for chemistry, alchemy, and brewing of any kind. Also a massive cauldron that is entirely unreactive to even the strongest of acids known to man, if you want something more large scale.

A leather satchel that is much larger on the inside than its outside dimensions would suggest and always just as light as if it were empty. Any raw material placed into the harvest bag has any and all supernatural qualities preserved as time seems to have less effect within the satchel as it does outside of it. 

Additionally, any raw material within can be used as if it were in hand of the satchel-holder, great for material-based spellcasting. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

A decently sized series of cabinets, large and small, that are fitted with a carefully tuned set of enchantments that allows time to be manipulated within. The cabinets have a number of shelves, each with a few timers and dials that allow you to accelerate or decelerate time, with a button to completely stop, or restart, the progress of time on a particular shelf. 

This can be programmed to change its current level of time acceleration or deceleration after a specific amount of time. The stasis and time differentials cannot cause any form of harm nor can it block someone from grabbing a stored item. Comes with an instruction manual.

A surprisingly light cauldron that naturally brings out and enhances the magical properties of materials placed inside of it. Potions made in this cauldron have twice the yield for the same amount of materials, last twice as long before they spoil, if at all, are generally more stable than they normally would be when it’s beneficial for you, and have a slightly higher potency than they would if made with a normal cauldron. The cauldron has a convenient spigot at its base and comes with flasks and vials to store the potions.

A collection of magical embers that can ignite into full flame when fed supernatural power. The flames produced are supernatural in nature and can be used to burn away elements within a material or object while leaving the rest of it intact, such as burning away the poison of wolfsbane but leaving the aspect that cures the curse of the werewolf. 

The embers themselves are only warm to the touch and will not harm the holder when ignited, allowing them to conjure the flames for other purposes as well, such as light, heat, or even self defense. Skilled users have learned to create patterns with the power they feed the flame to control how it manifests. Each ember produces flames with different properties.

A simple chest designed to safely store potions, keeping them in perfect conditions to last and not be broken. However, its main feature is a pair of glass tubes on the lid that, if each is fed a potion, will combine the two doses of potion into a single one with the effects of both, whether they have different or identical effects. 

These composite potions can be further combined, but each one after the first has a chance of the potions destabilizing and spoiling. There are also four slots in the side of the chest that will produce three copies of any potion fitted into the slot after 24 hours, so long as the potion doesn’t require exceptionally rare ingredients.

Also known as Quintessence or Chaos, the prima materia is a substance aligned almost exclusively with the element of aether, taking the form of a clay-like substance that seems to be all colors at once and an almost airy texture as it feels nearly weightless. The Prima Materia is able to act as a substitute for almost any substance used in alchemy as it takes on the properties of the substance necessary, though it can only be used to substitute for a single substance in any particular form of alchemy. This can even substitute for exceptionally rare materials or provide a bit of spiritual presence to what is made with it.

You gain a small, regenerating supply of this clay-like material. How much is needed for any particular substitute is determined by the properties it needs to duplicate.

An elaborate stone slab that has ancient writing printed onto it, explaining the basics of alchemy in a long dead language. Someone reading from this tablet will gain the power of an alchemist and develop abilities similar to those described in this document. If you were to read the tablet aloud, something you can do instinctively despite the dead language, the power of alchemy would spread to some of the people the world and grant alchemical abilities to them similar to if they had read the tablet, after which the tablet will crumble to dust.

Magic, as a whole, is a fairly nebulous term that can refer to any number of supernatural methodologies of effecting change or an action onto the world. This perk simply grants the minimum requirements to use the local form of magic, whatever form it takes. This applies to all local magic systems in setting. As an added benefit, you can grant this perk to others by effectively teaching them the basics of the local magic system, which can take some time. If there is no magic in your current world, this perk can be re-rolled for free.

You have the ability to ignore your exhaustion while working on a craft, at the cost of backlash later down the line. This allows you to work tirelessly for days at a time, so long as you supply your bodily needs otherwise. Once you are finished working, however, you will have a short window of time to settle yourself before you will crash and need to sleep once more, and will do so until you are caught back up.

You have a knack for finding teachers that are willing to impart their knowledge to you and take you on as an apprentice, you learn twice as fast when you have a teacher, and you can tell when a potential teacher is actually worth your time and effort.

You are a skilled teacher, able to adapt your lessons to your students to best teach them. This is best used with small groups where you can give one-on-one aid to your students. You are also able to spot good students and recognize their talents.
You know what your creations are worth and know, generally, how to make a proper sale with anything you make. This also gives you insights into the prices of similar objects to what you have created.

When you make something, you get an intimate knowledge of it and how it is to be used, making it easier for you to utilize them for their intended purposes. You will find you write more neatly with a pen you made than one bought off of a shelf, a sword you made would give you an edge in battle over a standard issue one, and similar such instances. This extends to items you’ve modified, though to a degree proportional to how thoroughly they were changed.

Your creations have an unusual property that makes them function better when they look good. A sword made of subpar materials and simple craftsmanship but that looks good will work just as well as one made with good materials and decent skill. A more well-made sword made to look just as good would function even better than it otherwise would. This improves upon every quality of the item.

Your creations are less likely to break down, are more durable, and need less maintenance to keep functioning. They will last, at least, ten times longer than they otherwise would unless actively broken, and even then, it will take more effort to break them.

You are practiced in one of the simplest forms of enchanting. This allows you to draw out some of the innate properties of a material or substance and allow it to project that property in some small fashion, such as the stress relieving qualities of an amethyst necklace. The effects of this are minor on their own, but can be combined with other forms of enchanting to create something more potent.

You have a talent and skill for modular design, able to create simple and efficient means of turning nearly any of your creations into something modular. This makes it incredibly easy to swap out components of your creations for others to make it better suited to your actual needs.

When you eat, drink, or sleep, you can choose to store up any excess as nebulous pools of energy you can use to fulfill those needs later. These are separate for each of the three pools you can draw from, but will sustain your needs well. This will prevent you from suffering the negatives of overindulging in such things. 

All three energies can be spent to replenish your other energy reserves, including your physical and mental stamina, preventing you from suffering from fatigue as long as you have the energy to spend. This only works if you use all three energies together, however.

You are skilled in all manner of crafts and have at least a foundation in any craft you come across even if you have never encountered or heard of it before. You learn crafting oriented skills roughly ten times more quickly. You can also reverse engineer techniques on how to make something by simply watching someone do so or examining the finished product for long enough.

You know how to put together a group of workers that will work together well and efficiently, promoting teamwork and a rhythm in the crafting. With this, you could turn a group of neophyte workers into a well oiled machine of crafting.

When working with any material while forging, you can make it act as if it were iron. Melting it, working it in the forge, and otherwise affecting it as if it were simple iron. Even ultra-durable and flame resistant materials could be worked as if they were iron in this way.

You have the knowledge of a runic language that is capable of taking in and shaping magic fed into it, as well as how to carve such runes into most solid surfaces. While somewhat simplistic in how it can be applied, these runes require no magical source beyond what the wielder can provide to function.

You have the ability to store nearly any supernatural powers or enchantments on paper and ink in the form of scrolls, grimoires, and spell tags. Such creations can carry the supernatural effect, bit of magic, or enchantment until it is used, at which point it is either used up or transfers the enchantment to a new object. Storing a spell, effect, or enchantment in this way uses all the same resources and requires the same level of focus, but can be triggered far more easily when the time comes to do so.

You have a knack for incorporating magics and supernatural abilities into your crafting and can split your focus effectively and easily between them. This gives you multiple streams of thought you can use to focus on various aspects of a project or task, making it easier to perform complex forms of enchanting.

You have the ability to incorporate a downside or negative quality into your creations, creating cursed magic items. More than this, you can tie the curse into another enchantment to enhance the quality of the enchantment. By tying in downsides, you strengthen whatever positives do exist.

You can perform a quick and dirty form of enchantment, allowing you to place a temporary version of any enchantment you can create onto an object with a fairly simple expenditure of power. These temporary enchantments will last for a short time, though this can be increased with training or by expending more resources, both in terms of power, time, and resources.
You are able to power an enchantment beyond its normal capacity, and do so safely. When doing so, the enchantment’s effects are enhanced proportional to the excess energy invested into the effect.

You can cause an enchanted object to destabilize and violently discorporate. This destroys the enchantment and causes an explosion with the lingering energies from the enchantment, the blast’s radius and power based on the amount of power in the enchantment. With time, you could potentially learn to shape how the magic expresses beyond just an explosion.

By inscribing a number upon a target and understanding its cultural or symbolic meaning, you can invoke effects tied to that number. A "7" might grant luck, while other numbers produce corresponding results. The potency, flexibility and versatility of the effect is determined by the universality of the number’s symbolism, the nature of its meaning, your comprehension of the theme, your skills at inscribing along with kind of art you use to do it, and the power you channel into the inscription while creating it.

With this meta-perk you can infuse items with the effects of your own perks, granting them enchantment-like properties. Crafting an item from scratch yields the best results, though personally modifying or rebuilding an existing item also works. Effects may be unpredictable at first, but experimentation and experience will improve your control, consistency, and ability to tailor the outcome. Your understanding of the perk, your crafting skill, and your conceptualization all influence the final result, as does the type of item used. Higher-cost perks are more difficult to infuse, while lower-cost perks are easier. This perk does not affect other meta-perks.

You find it easy to adapt to changes in your form. You never suffer from phantom pain or detrimental levels of body dysmorphia, and though you can still feel dissatisfied with the current state of your body for practical or aesthetic reasons, these feelings never inhibit your ability to function comfortably. You also have ‘flexible’ muscle memory, which operates in such a way that when your form is altered, you can treat your new shape as if you had just as much practice using it as your old shape. One form can still be less practical than another, but you at least won’t be held back by your lack of practice using it.

You have a knack for ‘inventing’ lifeforms which could exist, even if they currently don’t. You don’t just have a good understanding of how such lifeforms might operate, but also enough creativity to come up with such possibilities in the first place. And of course, if you become aware of biological properties that should be impossible, such as magical plants or creatures, you can come up with new ways in which those properties might be differently applied and figuring out how they would work in the most stable way possible.

Biomancers often specialise in interacting with certain types of lifeforms and their tissue, be it as plant-bending rulers of forests or gardens, or a creature-altering fleshcrafter. You have an affinity for using biomancy to interact with a specific kingdom of life. Choose one from the fields: Animalia; Plantae; Fungi; Bacteria. You can purchase additional field for 100 CO.

You are capable of channeling biomantic magic in an ‘inverted’ fashion. This effectively channels necromantic power, but only in a limited way. If you are also capable of necromancy, this lets you fuel it using methods that are normally rooted in biomancy, and lets you boost its effects using methods that would normally only enhance your biomancy. Even without any other grounding in necromancy, this lets you inflict necrosis and similar ailments on others with far greater ease than other biomancers might, and affect dead biological matter with biomancy as easily as you would living tissue.

You can temporarily alter the pH of any substance (not of living creatures or inside of them) within 10 meters at will. Turn water into acid strong enough to melt steel, or make it so alkaline it dissolves organic matter like tissue paper. Shifting pH beyond 0-14 (into superacids or superbases) is possible but drains significantly more energy the further you go. Your own body is immune to pH changes you cause.

You can alter the viscosity of any liquid within 15 meters. Turn oil into a solid gel to trap enemies, or make molten metal flow like water to slip through cracks. Make blood in a target's body so thick their heart strains, or so thin they bleed out from a paper cut. You cannot affect liquids inside living creatures without direct skin contact. Your own bodily fluids remain normal.

You touch an object or surface and change its thermal conductivity. Make a metal rod conduct heat so poorly that one end can be red-hot while you hold the other safely. Or make a stone wall conduct so perfectly that touching it transfers your body heat away in seconds, freezing you - or vice versa, dumping heat into an enemy through a handshake. Can last up to 10 minutes, requires touch to apply.

You alter the surface tension of any liquid you touch or see within 5 meters. Make water so "wet" (low tension) it seeps through any crack or membrane, or so "dry" (high tension) that it beads into marbles you can throw like grenades - they burst on impact with normal tension restored. Walk on a pond by increasing tension beneath your feet, or make rain bounce off you entirely. You cannot affect living creatures.

You can touch a metal object and drastically increase its oxidation potential. Iron rusts to dust in seconds. Copper verdigris spreads like moss. Aluminum develops a thick oxide crust and becomes brittle. You can also do the reverse: protect a metal from oxidation entirely, keeping it mirror-bright for weeks. Effects is temporarily, but long-lasting (up to a month). Requires touch to be applied.

You touch a container or puddle of two or more liquids and can control whether they mix or separate. Turn a shaken oil-vinegar dressing into perfect, stable emulsion - or instantly separate blood into plasma and cells (lethal). Force water and gasoline to mix into a flammable sludge that won't separate again. Remove alcohol from a drink by separating it to the surface where you can skim it off. Range: touch only, up to 50 liters per second.

You generate semi-solid light-constructs (blades, tendrils, orbs, filaments) that alter the hardness of whatever they touch, but they cannot damage anything by themselves. Works best on solids, but brief contact with liquids or gases can harden them into temporary unstable structures - walk on water or shatter a pocket of air like glass. Hardness change slows down the more you deviate from the target's original state (near-original is instant; diamond-soft or foam-hard takes seconds). Effect can be momentary (tied to the construct's presence) or lasting up to one hour at your choice.

You project and manipulate shapes of absolute blackness - each one a shaped event horizon. Any matter or energy touching their surface is deleted from existence. They cannot exist independently; moving too far away or dropping concentration makes them vanish. You telepathically move them within a limited radius around you, or hold them weightlessly in your hands. Getting very close to a surface produces a mild gravitational pull. Your own body is immune. Projecting more than three at a time or shaping one larger than a door causes rapid mental fatigue.

Once per 24 hours of subjective time, you may manifest a true, verifiable scientific paper on a research question of your choice. The paper is 100 pages long maximum, decently written, and accurate as of the moment of creation, but it is never complete, never revolutionary, and often cites nonexistent sources from other realities. 

To use this perk, you must possess basic understanding of the subject and formulate a clear thesis. It cannot produce tactical data, simple facts, prophecies, or non-scientific information. The paper is a powerful research assistant, not an answer engine: use it to bypass dead ends, validate hypotheses, or generate new directions, but be prepared to reconstruct missing knowledge through conventional study or additional papers.

Your intellect is increased to the highest levels that your species could naturally attain on your birthworld. This includes but is not limited to such things as common sense, perceptiveness, reaction time, coordination, pattern recognition, learning speed, and creativity. You do not merely have heightened technical aptitude or some other narrow depiction of 'intelligence', but a holistic, well-rounded g-factor intelligence that is equivalent to low-end comic-book genius. If you choose to remain at this Tier it is strongly encouraged that you buy at least some Perks to augment yourself, or else this isn’t really a ‘super’ intelligence story now is it?

Your intelligence includes everything in Genius, but boosted to outright superhuman levels. You think and mentally react multiple times faster than is humanly possible, to the point that you can see the world in 'bullet time' even if your physical capabilities are still mostly baseline. Your learning speed is much faster than normal, you can multitask several things at once, and what normal scientists would require mainframe computers to calculate is simple mental arithmetic for you. You are at the mythical 'IQ 300+' tier, even if that number doesn't actually mean anything on the conventional IQ scale. You are multiple times more brilliant than even the greatest geniuses in real-world history. Someone at the Augmented tier would roughly compare to an NZT user from ‘Limitless’, a Pak Protector from the ‘Known Space’ novels, or a 9th-level intellect from the DCU.

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 0: Genius

Your intelligence has advanced to a level almost beyond human comprehension. Your thought processes run at supercomputer speed, you assimilate new knowledge and skills almost instantly, and your faultless brain simply never slips, fumbles, or makes unforced errors. Your multitasking can easily fork dozens of complex processes while simultaneously processing all of your sensory inputs without strain. The accuracy of your thought processes is limited only by available data and (where applicable) chaos theory. Someone at the ‘Hyperbrain’ tier would roughly compare to a supercritical person from ‘Understand’, a Rick entity, or a 12th-level intellect from the DCU.

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 1: Augmented

A mind as powerful as yours would be far too dangerous if allowed to slip into Malign Hypercognition Disorder, so your Benefactor will provide you with a free immunity to insanity and idealized mental mechanisms for processing and resolving trauma and stress. Your superintelligence will not change your personality in any unwanted ways, you will suffer no loss of empathy from being vastly greater in mentality than those around you, and you will be immune to boredom. Barring Drawback-fiat you will never lose control of your emotions unless you choose to.

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 0: Genius

As a bonus, your Benefactor will upgrade the more 'normal' photographic memory available as part of the general boosted intelligence package to a Jumper-grade perfect memory with all the trimmings. Unlimited storage, instant recall, perfect indexing, tamper-proofing, fully retroactive, 'hidden storage', all of that. After all, you came to this Gauntlet to prepare your brain for the jumpchain.

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 0: Genius

While sufficient intellect can already let Jumper gain the maximum amount of acuity and perceptiveness possible from their sensory organs, including capacities that unaugmented humans don’t normally use, this perk allows Jumpers to outright cheat beyond even that extent. Scent like a bloodhound’s, vision like a hawk’s, hearing that can sense heartbeats over a room away through a noisy crowd, echolocation using ambient sounds… you’re essentially a non-blind version of Daredevil. You will never have any problems with sensory overload.

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 0: Genius

Your augmented intellect now has rigorous data security, fault-detection, and anti-subversion countermeasures. You are immune to unwanted mind-reading, mental intrusion, or mental influence of any kind, even that which comes from supernatural charisma or social skills. You may, if you wish, pretend to be mind-read or mind-controlled - even to the point of presenting edited data to the hostile telepath.

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 0: Genius

Making highly advanced and/or long-range plans and strategies, layering multiple contingencies, or rapidly adapting to unexpected situations are things that any superintelligent entity can do even without this perk. What this perk does is boost your ability to scheme and manipulate from merely being augmented to being a thing out of legend. 

Despite not having precognition people would still believe that you could see the future if they knew of your schemes, and your plans will have an amazingly high likelihood of success even when they ‘logically’ shouldn’t. It's still possible for you to fail, but only by encountering a situation entirely outside the context of what you could possibly have prepared for... or via your own hubris.

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 0: Genius

Your augmented intellect has adapted to have full awareness of and total control over all of your body’s functions and every individual muscle fiber. Your heartbeat, respiration, metabolism, and everything else now function on optimized neural algorithms that can run autonomously or under your mind's conscious direction as you choose. 

Simple tricks like blocking out pain sensation, maintaining physical fitness without exercise, consciously channeling bursts of adrenaline, or resisting disease and speeding the body's healing are child's play to you. You possess flawless aim, perfect balance, ideal kinesthetic sense and timing, and make every physical motion with the precision of a supercomputer-controlled cyborg (even if you aren't one).

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 0: Genius

While any superintelligent person can of course master all sorts of technical fields and create all sorts of amazing inventions, you are somehow able to partially substitute raw intellect for time, quality materials, or specialized manufacturing facilities. You can create your wondrous inventions in a cave with a box of scraps, do things on a garage workbench that would normally require ‘clean room’ microcircuit assembly facilities, and iterate and innovate multiple times faster than even a comparable superintelligence without this perk could.

>Requires: Intellect - Tier 0: Genius

"Ember Red is the color of flames and other sources of heat."

You have the ability to produce and manipulate flames and heat. Create flamethrowers or walls of fire, melt metal with your hands, and shape it as if it was clay.

You gain access to fire-related enchantments: for example, you may spend some time casting to make fire impossible to extinguish through normal means for up to a week or enchant targets to become completely heat-proof.

You are immune to the adverse effects of fire and heat and in the presence of natural sources you are stronger and can regenerate from damage more quickly.

"Sanguine Scarlet is the color of blood and lifeforce."

You can control and manipulate blood from open wounds or blood in general in contact with air. You may harden it and shape it in a variety of fragile constructs. 

Moreover, you may drink blood for sustenance and to increase your strength, agility, reflexes, and durability temporarily. The potency and duration of effects depend on how much blood you have consumed. If you completely drain someone, you may instead increase your lifespan by the number of years the victim would have naturally survived. An old person may give you less than 5, a healthy young adult more than 40.

"Powerful Crimson is the color of power and destruction. The strongest in terms of pure offense, but it lacks versatility."

You can shoot energetic projections in different shapes (missiles, waves, lasers, explosions, bolt barrages, lances, spikes, etc...). The more time you spend casting an attack the stronger, the quicker and the farther it will travel to hit/destroy the target. During casting, you can add esoteric properties to your attacks, making them self-hit a flying target for example, or appear all around a standing target before launching on it. Attacks cast on the fly make you as dangerous as an assault rifle and by spending some time casting you can create stronger projections. You are not immune to the damage you cause.

"Turning Orange is the color of evolution and adaptation."

You can turn partially or totally into other people, animals, plants, or fungi you know. Your transformation is easier when complete, while it's harder to maintain a chimeric form made up of different creatures together. The more creatures the harder.

This power enables you to mimic the natural abilities of whatever you turn into. Elephant strength? Plant's photosynthesis? All on the table. Solely physical ones, though, which means you cannot turn into the Nobel Prize for Physics and get their intelligence.

Be careful, you are not immune to an identity crisis.

"Building Burgundy is the color of shapes and ideas."

You have to power to generate and manipulate energy constructs. This power requires constant focus to work efficiently and can mimic any shape that comes to mind. Simple ones like disks, cubes, or spheres are much easier to produce, but with sufficient concentration, you can make much more complex ones like work utensils, weapons or animals, and so on. Making a phone will not make it function: it simply possesses the shape. Depending on how much time you invest in creating a construct you can make it as strong as to resist hundreds to thousands of pounds of force. 

You may enchant your constructs to function autonomously following simple commands.

"Earthy Brown is the color of earth-related materials such as stones, minerals, sand, and the earth itself."

You may control natural earth-related materials and generate and manipulate magical replicas. The latter will disappear from existence after a few hours. You may stabilize them for up to a week, however, if you expend enough time casting (upkeep to extend it) - counts as enchantment. Your control over earth-related material requires concentration - with enough focus you may hurl boulders worth hundreds to thousands of kgs, cause earthquakes, or make life-like sculptures.

You also gain access to earth-related enchantments, for example, you may enchant objects to give them the same hardness as a diamond or make a rock magically crumble into sand in a few seconds. 

Finally, you may sense tremors through the earth and may consume natural earth-related materials as food. You are immune to the adverse effects of the element.

"Alchemic Gold is the color of experimentation and discovery."

You may produce potions using mundane materials and infusing them with magic.
 
Alchemic Gold will extract conceptual properties from the ingredients to produce a magical effect that can be used when the potion is drunk, applied like an ointment, splashed, breathed, etc...

For example, you may make a potion starting from a few feathers to make anyone who drinks it incredibly light for a limited amount of time. Instead, by using entire wings, you may make functional wings sprout on the back of a target. Another one may require the color of a dye and gain the ability to change the color of an entire building if splashed on the walls. The more time you spend on making the potion and the more in quantity and the more expensive the materials, the stronger and longer lasting the effects will be. With enough experimentation and resources, you may achieve almost anything. Be careful not to hurt yourself with uncontrollable effects!

"Luminous Yellow is the color of light and illusion."

You have the ability to generate and manipulate light. 

You may produce blinding flashes, bend light to become invisible, or produce convincing visual illusions. This power requires constant concentration to function correctly, especially if the generated illusions are complex or animated. If you spend time creating an illusion, you may make it run autonomously, make it cover entire towns, and add to it sound, temperature, touch, and scent (the more time you spend making it the more effects it can have/the larger the area it will cover - enchantments). Your illusions may never physically harm anyone.

"Restoring Honey is the color of healing and restoring."

You have the power to heal wounds and diseases. Papercuts and other superficial wounds are much easier to treat, requiring a few seconds of concentration. Anything more complex requires a lengthy ritual to heal, the more complex the case the more time is required. While you are using your power on a patient, they will enter a stasis where they cannot die, nor worsen, until you have finished. Healing a mortal wound can take up to hours. 

You may repair broken objects, too, restoring them to functionality. The greater the damage and the larger the objects the more taxing it will be. 

Finally, you may cast protective enchantments called blessings. These will passively heal, regenerate and repair your targets, counteracting damage as soon as it happens. They act much more slowly than your active intervention, however.

"Techno Lime is the color of technology and advancement."

You have the power to manipulate technology, aka anything manmade through the application of scientific knowledge. Computers, cars, complex machinery, cell phones, and the like all fall under this category. You may interface with them mentally to access their contents and control them. For example, you may activate and guide a car remotely, or project your consciousness into the internet to navigate it. Your mind is strong enough not to crack under the complexity or sheer load of information.

If you have a blueprint in mind, you may telekinetically assemble the parts to create it. You have a natural propensity for learning the appropriate knowledge required to build any of your projects, but you still need to study and apply what you learned for the projects to be realized.

"Living Green is the color of life, plant, animal, and fungi alike."

You may manipulate nonsentient life: plants, fungi, and animals. 

Plants and fungi are the easiest to manipulate - make them move and bend to unnatural degrees or make the extend many times beyond their length. With an enchantment, you may accelerate their growth, making them sprout from seeds or spores in a matter of a few seconds.  Moreover, you can mix and match plant and fungi traits, creating new species that would be impossible to exist otherwise.

Control over animals is a little different - you may communicate with them and ask for aid or you may try to force control over their minds. The smaller and fewer the animals you attempt to control at a time, the easier it will be. Also, you may mix and match animal traits, creating new hybrid species, much like what you can do with plants and fungi. 

Be careful, however, not to let any of your newly created species run rampant.

"Chaotic Emerald is the color of chaos and probability."

You can enchant creatures or locations with good or bad luck, increasing the probability of positive events or negative events to occur respectively. Of course, the greater the degree of good or bad luck "gifted" the more it will tire you out. Moreover, you may try to establish precisely what these events will be, costing you more the more improbable or impossible the event. Making something that would naturally occur is easier: let's say, a car mysteriously shutting down while moving. Instead, making a piano fall on the head of an enemy while in the middle of the desert will require much more of your energy.

Finally, you may meditate to see how your choices may branch out in countless possible futures. This won't be a perfect prediction of what's to come, but it may give you an idea of what are the most probable outcomes of your decisions.

"Astral Teal is the color of the astral plane and the manipulation of souls."

You may project your consciousness through Astral Teal as an Astral Projection. It moves at the speed of thought (just think of a place and your consciousness will be transported there) and enables you to perceive distant locations with all of your senses. You may not interact with matter or people, nor use other Colors while Astral Projecting. Your body is still vulnerable. 
You may push other people out of their bodies to travel with you and you may possess temporarily soul-less and living bodies, engaging in a battle of will with the owner for control. Your body cannot be possessed, since the other Colors (the majority of your Soul) will still be present.

You may fragment Astral Teal and use it to possess objects and animate them. You can spend some time shaping personality and level of intelligence of these animated objects. The more, larger and more complex the personality/intelligence of the animated objects the harder it will be to maintain them. They count as enchantments and can be recipients of the Soul Fragments PERK.

For short periods of time, you may shift entirely into the Astral Plane with your body too, becoming invisible and intangible and capable of flight. You may not move at the speed of thought when shifting the body, however, being limited to short bursts of flight in the vicinity. This is extremely tiring and usually considered an emergency move.

"Moving Cyan is the color of movement and freedom."

You gain telekinetic abilities over your surroundings, enabling you to move hundreds to thousands of kgs with ease. This power requires constant concentration to work effectively. With enough focus you may toss manipulated targets, apply force to break them, or stop a flying object in midair (if you can perceive it). 

You may even levitate passively up to a meter from the ground and move up to running speed, but with focus, you may launch yourself in a controlled flight at hundreds of km/h with a telekinetic shield sufficient to protect you from adverse flying conditions like temperature, lack of oxygen or impact with insects, but it won't protect you from a flying bullet or hitting a hard surface at full speed for example.

By spending some time casting you may apply telekinesis-related enchantments to targets, removing the force of gravity from affecting them for example, locking them at a certain height, or programming flying trajectories.

"Cloudy Azure is the color of air and weather phenomena."

You can manipulate natural air and electricity or produce magical replicas. Create tornadoes, lightning from your fingertips, or cutting winds, and use air to propel yourself freely in the sky. You gain weather-related enchantments that enable you to control weather phenomena happening in an area, and program them for up to a week (upkeep is possible). Make it rain, thunder, or hail. Call forth fog and mist or clear the area from pollution and let the sunshine.

Finally, you are immune to the adverse effects of air and electricity and have no need for breathing.

"Deep Blue is the color of water and cold."

You have the ability to control natural water and ice and generate and manipulate magical replicas. The latter will disappear from existence after a few hours if not stabilized with an enchantment. You may turn water into ice and vice versa at will. With enough focus, you may manipulate hundreds to thousands of gallons of water, cause waves and tsunamis or generate ice constructs from moisture in the air. 

You gain water and ice-related enchantments, enabling you to encase targets in ice that doesn't melt or create floating rivers, for example. 

Finally, you are most comfortable in the water, enabling you to swim incredibly fast, breathe underwater, and resist water pressure. Moreover, you have a resistance to the adverse effects of cold.

"Dimensional Indigo is the color of dimensions and portals."

You gain the power to generate and manipulate portals, which may be 2D or 3D. 

2D portals can appear on surfaces or float in mid-air and enable objects to move through them in two directions, while 3D ones take the shape of the target and teleport it to another unoccupied location. You may generate portals and teleport within line of sight with ease. With an enchantment, you may instead create portals linking to different locations you can picture in your mind. The more time spent, the larger the portal. 

Moreover, you gain a personal dimension of near-limitless size you can access through specifically crafted portals. The dimension appears as Indigo all around, with a dark sky and a flat surface underneath. All objects are perfectly illuminated in all directions and project no shadow. You can create fake matter in the personal dimension, but you cannot carry it out of it. Transporting real matter in and out is more taxing, since you're moving it from one dimension to another.

"Eldritch Midnight is the color of darkness, mystery, and the unknown. The Void and the creatures that inhabit it."

You can conjure and manipulate magical darkness. It cannot interact with physical matter. You possess perfect dark vision and, while hidden in darkness, you may call forth beings of various power from the void. They require appropriate sacrifices to be summoned and comply with your requests, starting from food for weak creatures that may perform mundane tasks such as cleaning your house, while stronger ones may require blood, memories, or human lives for more esoteric tasks. If the sacrifice isn't enough they will simply go back to the void, losing power over reality. 

You may meditate in darkness to project your consciousness to safely visit the void and acknowledge or even befriend different beings. 

Be careful, your body might be safe, but you might not recover from the horrors you may witness. There are creatures far more powerful than you are, but if you are clever enough you may find ways to make them work for you.

"Dreamy Orchid is the color of dreams and fantasy."

You have the ability to lucid dream and traverse the dreams of others. You may script dreams to your liking and to the finest detail, setting, characters, and plot. You may manipulate the flow of time in the dream to your liking, making thousands of years happen in a few real seconds if you so wish.

While sleeping your body is vulnerable, however, your physiological processes halt keeping you in an immortal, unaging stasis where you do not need to eat, drink or go to the bathroom, etc... Moreover, you can induce drowsiness to outright blackout sleep to others in your vicinity (depending on how strong they are) and overwrite their dreams with your scripted ones. 

With an enchantment you may curse a target to sleep for up to a week without waking up - magically sleeping targets also have their physiological processes halted.

"Psychic Purple is the color of the mind, thoughts and memories."

You may read surface thoughts of nearby creatures without them noticing and send telepathic messages that can carry words or mental images - if you're careful the target may think these are their own thoughts and act upon them as a form of suggestion. With some concentration, you may even share their senses, see through their eyes, hear through their ears, etc... While meditating you may instead reach a faraway target you know. The further away and the less acquainted you are the harder it will be. 

Moreover, by touching a target you may probe deeper into their mind reaching their own personal Mindscape, a dimension generated by the subconscious. If you learn to navigate it without getting lost, you may reach the target's memories and centers of personality and retrieve, delete, or modify information as you see fit. You may set up mental wards in your own Mindscape to prevent this and in general explore it and get to know yourself better.

"Warping Mauve is the color of space, playing with the rules of physics."

You have the ability to temporarily alter space in a location or on a target without damaging it. 

You may change the sizes of targets, turn a mouse the size of an elephant and vice versa, or zip the space between you and a faraway building you can see, effectively enabling you to move from one location to the next with a single step. 

You may enchant containers or rooms to increase their storage size without changing the exterior, for example enabling a water bottle to store an Olympic pool's worth of water. Finally, you may change the shape and physical properties of targets without affecting anything else - you may make an elephant as light as a feather or change the shape of your fingers into squishy flesh tentacles. The weirder and grander the effect, the more taxing it will be to realize.

"Prophetic Fuchsia is the color of information collection and storage."

You have the ability to gather information through esoteric means, such as using tarot cards, interpreting the stars in the sky, or tossing bones (for example). The information that can be gathered may be in the form of visions from the past or future or real-time viewing of a remote target/location. The visions may involve one or more of your senses and may range from being straightforward to cryptic. You may need objects related to the information you wish to gather in order for the visions to be clearer. 

Moreover, you may store information within objects/locations that can be transmitted as visions to anyone you choose who is in the vicinity/touching the storage. 

Finally, you gain perfect memory and hyper-awareness of your surroundings, nothing will ever catch you completely off guard. (You also gain sufficient mental fortitude to deal with all this information).

"Aura Pink is the color of emotions and feelings."

You have the ability to sense the emotions of those nearby by interpreting their colorful auras. Each color corresponds to an emotion and the more vibrant the more intense it will be. You know how to interpret them and how to manipulate them in a variety of ways: for example, you may make people share an emotion, you may remove it temporarily or totally, or, with a bit more difficulty, create new ones. This power can work at a distance if you take time to meditate and know the target well enough.

Moreover, you gain the ability to craft Emotional Elementals, physical representations of emotions, from particularly strong ones (either yours or of others). Their mere presence will overpower most with their own emotions and they can have powers of their own themed powers. You may lose control of them if you summon too many. They are countered by an opposite, equally strong emotion or peace of mind.  Examples: an Anger elemental will have fire and berserk-based abilities, its mere presence making people violent.

"Warding Pearl is the color of protection, wards, and shields. The strongest in terms of pure defense."

You have the ability to set up Wards protecting creatures, objects, or entire locations from harm. They can be created with certain rules in mind, for example, they may enable the entrance of an area only by a selected few or protect those they guard against poisonous gases. You may set up multiple wards on a target/location, each following a single rule (either general protection from harm or specific rules). You may also ward against specific Colors, making much more powerful wards for the Colors you possess. 

The more time you spend creating a ward the stronger and/or larger it will be, with no upper limit. A fraction of a second may protect from a bullet before dissipating, while a few hours may protect from tank explosions. Wards count as enchantments, needing weekly upkeep to keep on functioning or they will lose strength with time. Moreover, the longer they are under attack the quicker they will dissipate (unless they are actively maintained by you).

"Necro Bone is the color of death, bones, and ghosts."

You may control dead matter and instill it with fake life. The more time you spend creating a servant, the more intelligent and or strong you may make it - this counts as an enchantment. They may even retain the knowledge of when they were alive. Your servants can also be created as an amalgamation of various body parts, though they take longer to make than simply reanimate a single body. Any servant you create this way can be a recipient for the PERK Soul Fragments.

Finally, you have the ability to summon the souls of the dead in the form of roaming ghosts. The more recent the death and the closer you are to the location where they died or where their remains are, the easier it will be to call them forth. You have the power to decide when to send them back to the afterlife, though strong-willed ghosts may try to wrestle for it. A summoned ghost keeps all their memories, identity, and agency, they may decide to collaborate with you or not, even possessing one of your servants.

"Disprupting Obsidian is the color of antimagic and dispelling."

You gain the ability to passively sense magic and other Iridescent Souls in the vicinity. You may dispel active magical effects with various degrees of difficulty: if you possess the matching Color it will be much easier, while if you don't it will take you much more time to undo it. A stronger effect, moreover, requires more time on your part to disable it. 

You may set up antimagic enchantments (called curses) on targets or areas that prevent any use of magic.
